words.trans: （费力地）攀爬；手脚并用地爬。强调动作笨拙、吃力，需要手脚并用。
examples: He had to clamber through trees for half an hour to get to the edge of the water.

words.trans: 水边；岸边。指水与陆地交界的地方。
examples: He pushed through the trees to get to the edge of the water without being seen.

words.trans: 电影拍摄现场；片场。
examples: The bay was as busy as a film set.

words.trans: 与……同时发生；与……一致/相符。
examples: The study centre was being opened to coincide with the start of the Lakes Summer Festival.

words.trans: 一阵突如其来的（恐慌/震惊/惊讶/恐惧）。jolt 本意是"震动、颠簸"，这里比喻情绪上的猛然冲击。
examples: He felt a jolt of panic as the helicopter came into view.

words.trans: v. 悄悄地移动；爬行；（植物）蔓延。过去式 crept。
examples: He crept through the trees in a wide arc.

words.trans: 强行穿过；挤过。强调用力量推开障碍或人群。
examples: The bushes were bare enough inside for him to force his way through.

words.trans: 树叶的沙沙声。
examples: The machine came down with a rustle of leaves.

words.trans: n./v.（使）发出沙沙声，常用于树叶、纸张、丝绸等。
examples: The machine came down with a rustle of leaves.

words.trans: 挡住出口；堵住出路。
examples: A man was standing in front of him, blocking the way out.

words.trans: 出现；到场（姗姗来迟）。≈ show up，但 show up 更口语常用；turn up 略带"总算姗姗来迟、终于冒出来"的语感，潜台词：我等你好久了，你总算来了。
examples: I was wondering when you were going to turn up.
Don't worry, he'll turn up sooner or later.

words.trans: adj. 严峻的；冷酷的；令人沮丧的；也可形容人表情严肃坚定。
examples: The pilot took in Tom's expression with a grim satisfaction.

words.trans: （口语）足足、整整，强调数量足够多。a good six inches taller 足足高了六英寸。
examples: He was a good six inches taller than Tom.

words.trans: 离做某事只差几秒；马上就要做某事，强调迫在眉睫。
examples: I was seconds away from calling a full-scale terror alert.

words.trans: n. 恼怒；烦躁；无奈。比 anger 更强调因反复受挫而产生的烦躁感。
examples: The pilot scratched his neck, exasperation in his voice.

words.trans: n./v. 责备、谴责，语气比 blame 更文雅。
examples: The word was full of reproach.

words.trans: 充满责备的；满是责怪的目光/语气。
examples: 'Oh,' the word was full of reproach.

words.trans: 留意观察；提防；警惕搜寻。
examples: What were you looking at, instead of keeping a lookout for other aircraft?

words.trans: 字面"一臂之遥"，引申"保持距离、不让某人靠太近（情感或物理上）"。常用 keep sb at arm's length / hold sth at arm's length。
examples: He held the drone at arm's length, feeling its weight.

words.trans: 从零开始；从头做起。指没有借助任何现成的东西。
examples: You made this? From scratch?

words.trans: 雕刻；塑造。既指用石头黏土做雕塑，也比喻精心打造外形。
examples: Flawless aerodynamic sculpting, perfectly balanced delta wing.

words.trans: 气动外形塑造。为让物体更符合空气动力学而设计、打磨外形。
examples: Flawless aerodynamic sculpting, perfectly balanced delta wing.

words.trans: 三角翼。平面形状像希腊字母 Δ 的三角形机翼，常见于高速飞机。
examples: A perfectly balanced delta wing, no less.

words.trans: 三螺旋桨布局。飞机采用三个螺旋桨的动力布置方式。
examples: Triple prop configuration: two forwards and a pusher at the back.

words.trans: 航空里指"推进式螺旋桨/推进式布局"，即螺旋桨装在机身后部，把飞机向前"推"。
examples: Two props forwards and a pusher at the back.

words.trans: 垂直起飞。
examples: All able to swivel up, so you can lift off vertically like a helicopter.

words.trans: 固定翼飞机。靠机翼产生升力，区别于直升机。
examples: You can fly horizontally with the speed of a fixed-wing aeroplane.

words.trans: 英式口语表达。kit 这里指装备/工具/东西；a nice bit of 表示"相当不错的、真够厉害的"。Nice bit of kit! 相当不错的装备！
examples: Perfectly balanced delta wing. Nice bit of kit!

words.trans: 用手指快速轻弹。flick a piece of dirt 弹掉一小块灰尘。
examples: He flicked a piece of dirt from the fuselage.

words.trans: adj/adv 口语。完全的；全力以赴的；毫不保留的；强度很大的。
examples: It would take a full-on aeronautical genius to make a tricopter like this.

words.trans: adj. 航空（学）的。
examples: It would take a full-on aeronautical genius to make a tricopter like this.

words.trans: vt. 使惊吓；使吃惊。强调突然的、短暂的惊吓。
examples: The question startled him.

words.trans: n.（飞机的）机身。飞机主体结构，不含机翼和尾翼。
examples: He flicked a piece of dirt from the fuselage.

words.trans: adj. 有血有肉的；活生生的。强调真实的人而非虚构或机器。
examples: Here was a flesh-and-blood helicopter pilot quizzing him.

words.trans: v.（随意地）披；覆盖；悬挂。n. 垂褶；窗帘。
examples: The life vest draped around the pilot's shoulders obscured his name badge.

words.trans: adj. 模糊的；晦涩的；不出名的（an obscure village 偏僻的小村庄）；v. 遮蔽；使模糊（Clouds obscured the moon）。
examples: The life vest obscured the pilot's name badge.

words.trans: n. 模糊；默默无闻；晦涩。fall into obscurity 渐渐无人问津。
examples: The old book fell into obscurity after its author died.

words.trans: n./v. 辫子；编织；（军装装饰用的）穗带。
examples: Tom recognized his shoulder braid as that of a squadron leader.

words.trans: （英国皇家空军的）中队长，军衔名，缩写 Sqn Ldr。
examples: Tom recognized the shoulder braid as that of a squadron leader.

words.trans: 风洞。用于测试空气动力学性能的实验设备。
examples: I made a wind tunnel in my workshop.

words.trans: 把（某人的）装备卡住/弄坏/干扰信号。
examples: I wouldn't have jammed your kit if you were just a hobby flyer.

words.trans: 四处打探；窥探。带有好奇或可疑的意味。
examples: You just happened to be nosing around a sector under surveillance.

words.trans: 在监视之下；被监控。
examples: You were nosing around a sector under surveillance.

words.trans: 英式口语动词。注意到；看到；瞥见；认出。
examples: You took evasive action when we clocked you.

words.trans: 采取规避动作/回避措施。常用于军事、航空或驾驶场景。
examples: You took evasive action when we clocked you.

words.trans: 面临（困难、对手等）；与……对抗。近义 come up against / be up against it。
examples: I need to know who I'm up against here when I'm talking to you.

words.trans: 一刹那、一瞬间。
examples: For a fraction of a second some part of him wondered whether this was real.

words.trans: 在山谷间俯冲穿梭。
examples: When he flew he was always alone, swooping through the valleys.

words.trans: 掠过嶙峋崎岖的山顶。
examples: He flew alone, skimming the craggy tops.

words.trans: 被撂在原地像具空壳。形容人沉浸在飞行里，躯体像空壳一样。
examples: His body sat in the workshop, left behind like a shell.

words.trans: 字面"膀胱要炸了"，即"憋尿憋得受不了"，口语常用，带夸张和幽默感。
examples: Sometimes he'd land and realize his bladder was bursting.

words.trans: n.（衣服下摆、袖口等的）折边、贴边；v. 给……折边、缝贴边。
examples: Between his flying glove and the hem of his sleeve he saw a tiny tattoo.

words.trans: v. 描绘；刻画。比 describe 更正式，常指用文字或画面呈现。
examples: A tiny tattoo depicting a running man with wings.

words.trans: 沉浸；浸没。可指物理浸入，也可指全身心投入某事。
examples: The part still catching up from the immersion of his flight earlier.

words.trans: 某人内心的某个部分；在某种程度上。表达隐约的、不愿完全承认的感受。≈ deep down。
examples: For a second some part of him wondered whether this conversation was real.

words.trans: adj. 困惑的；茫然的；发呆的。注意与 amused（被逗乐的）形近但意思完全不同，常被混淆。
examples: His aunt stood there looking bemused.

words.trans: 变得清晰；聚焦；明确。可指镜头对焦，也比喻事情逐渐明朗。bring sth into focus / come into focus。
examples: He forced himself to bring the two worlds of his existence into focus.

words.trans: 振作精神、稳住心神、整理情绪。
examples: He gathered himself together and held his hand out for the drone.

words.word: the tiniest hint of a smile
words.trans: 一丝极淡的笑意。hint 指细微的迹象、一点点；tiniest 是 tiny 最高级，强调最微弱。
examples: The tiniest hint of a smile flickered on the pilot's face.

words.trans: （表情、情绪）在某人脸上一闪而过。flicker 本意闪烁、摇曳（如火焰忽明忽暗），形容表情强调短暂、转瞬即逝。
examples: The tiniest hint of a smile flickered on his face, then was gone.

words.trans: （在水中或空气中）上下浮动、飘忽游荡。强调没有固定方向地轻轻上下晃动。
examples: Tom could see divers bobbing around the hull of the Teal.

words.trans: 我会盯着你的。常带威胁、警告意味，也可开玩笑地说。
examples: But I'll be watching you, Tom Hopkins.

words.trans: 与某人相遇；碰到某人。常指偶然相遇，有时带"挡路、招惹"意味。
examples: If that drone crosses my path again, I'll blast it into the middle of next week.

words.trans: 夸张的口语表达。字面"把某人/某物炸到下星期去"，实为狠狠打击、猛击、彻底击溃。同类 blast it to kingdom come（彻底炸毁、炸上天）。
examples: If that drone crosses my path again, I'll blast it into the middle of next week.
